MAINFORM.NAME: MAINFORM
MAINFORM.CAPTION: Rekapitulacija po skladištima
MAINFORM.ONLOADED: select KlRobaSortKey = case @@CBKlasa when 0 then 'disable' else 'enable' end, KlRobaIspod = case @@CBKlasa when 0 then 'disable' else 'enable'end#select 'invisible' as gridKl, 'invisible' as gridroba#select 'disable' as cmdStrukRoba, 'disable' as CmdKartica

INPUT.NAME: VrstaDokId
INPUT.SQL: select vd.VrstaDokId, vp.Sifra+' '+ vd.opis as Naziv from VrstaDok vd inner join VrstaProm vp on vd.VrstaPromId = vp.VrstaPromId where vp.RobnoInd is not null order by vp.Sifra

INPUT.NAME: Tip
INPUT.SQL: select 'G' as Tip, 'G - gotovih proizvoda' as Naziv union all select 'O' as Tip, 'O - osnovna sredstva' as Naziv union all select 'S' as Tip, 'S - sirovina' as Naziv union all select 'T' as Tip, 'T - trgovačke robe' as Naziv

INPUT.NAME: OrgShemaSortKey
INPUT.SQL: select SortKey as OrgShemaSortKey, replicate(' ',len(SortKey))+Naziv from OrgShema

INPUT.NAME: KlRobaSortKey
INPUT.SQL: select SortKey as KlRobaSortKey, replicate(' ', len(SortKey))+Naziv as Naziv from KlMasterRoba order by SortKey asc

INPUT.NAME: CBKlasa
INPUT.CAPTION: Klasa
INPUT.ONCLICK: select KlRobaSortKey = case @@CBKlasa when 1 then 'enable' else 'disable' end, KlRobaIspod = case @@CBKlasa when 1 then 'enable' else 'disable' end#select KlRobaSortKey = case @@CBKlasa when 1 then @@KlRobaSortKey else '' end

INPUT.NAME: cmdStrukRoba
INPUT.CAPTION: Struktura
INPUT.ONCLICK: select form = case when @@SkladisteId is not null then 'STRUKTURA' else 'GRESKA' end#select 'refresh' as gridstruktura, @@gridgridrobamId as RobaId

INPUT.NAME: cmdRoba
INPUT.CAPTION: Po Robi
INPUT.ONCLICK: select 'refresh' as gridroba #select 'visible' as gridroba #select 'invisible' as gridskl #select 'invisible' as gridkl #select 'visible' as CmdIspisiRoba #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisiKl #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisiskl #select 'enable' as CmdStrukRoba #select @@rowcountgridroba as status #select 'enable' as cmdKartica

INPUT.NAME: cmdKlasa
INPUT.CAPTION: Po Klasi
INPUT.ONCLICK: select 'refresh' as gridkl #select 'visible' as gridkl #select 'invisible' as gridskl #select 'invisible' as gridroba #select 'visible' as CmdIspisikl #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisisKl #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisiRoba #select 'disable' as cmdStrukRoba #select @@rowcountgridkl as status #select 'disable' as cmdKartica

INPUT.NAME: cmdSklad
INPUT.CAPTION: Po Skladištu
INPUT.ONCLICK: select 'refresh' as gridskl #select 'visible' as gridskl #select 'invisible' as gridroba #select 'invisible' as gridkl #select 'visible' as CmdIspisiSkl #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisiKl #select 'invisible' as cmdIspisiRoba #select 'disable' as cmdStrukRoba #select @@rowcountgridskl as status #select 'disable' as cmdKartica

INPUT.NAME: cmdKartica
INPUT.CAPTION: Kartica
INPUT.ONCLICK: select form = case when @@SkladisteId is not null then 'KARTICA' else 'GRESKA' end

STRUKTURA.NAME: STRUKTURA
STRUKTURA.CAPTION: @@NazivK
STRUKTURA.ONLOAD: select NazivK=( select rtrim(ltrim(CONVERT(char,r.UserId)))+' : '+ltrim(rtrim(r.Naziv))+' : ' +ltrim(rtrim(k.Naziv)) from Roba r inner join KlMasterRoba k on k.KlMasterRobaId=r.KlMasterRobaId where robaid=@@gridgridrobamId) , NazivN=(select ltrim(rtrim(Naziv)) from Roba where robaid=@@gridgridrobamId), SKNaziv=(select Opis from Skladiste where SkladisteId=@@SkladisteId)

INPUT.NAME: gridStruktura
INPUT.PAGEHEADERCENTER: Struktura stanja za robu : @@NazivN na skladištu : @@SkNaziv !! u preiodu od @@datumod. do @@datumdo.

KARTICA.NAME: KARTICA
KARTICA.CAPTION: @@NazivK
KARTICA.ONLOAD: select NazivK = ( select rtrim(ltrim(CONVERT(char, r.UserId)))+' : '+ltrim(rtrim(r.Naziv))+' : ' +ltrim(rtrim(k.Naziv)) from Roba r inner join KlMasterRoba k on k.KlMasterRobaId = r.KlMasterRobaId where robaid = @@gridgridrobamId) , NazivN = ( select rtrim(ltrim(CONVERT(char, UserId)))+' : '+ltrim(rtrim(Naziv)) from Roba where robaid = @@gridgridrobamId) , SKNaziv = (select Opis from Skladiste where SkladisteId = @@SkladisteId)

INPUT.NAME: gridKartica
INPUT.PAGEHEADERCENTER: Kartica za robu : @@NazivN / kom na skladištu : @@SkNaziv !! u preiodu od @@datumod. do @@datumdo.

INPUT.NAME: lblgreska
INPUT.CAPTION: Kako biste otvorili karticu trebate izabrati skladište.
